about.alhamdulillahBody: All praise belongs to Allah, who revealed His Book and made it easy to remember. Qariah was built out of love for the Qur'an and for the women whose voices carry it. We ask Allah to accept this small effort and make it a source of good for our daughters and for the whole Ummah.
about.missionBody: Qariah celebrates the recitation of the Holy Qur'an by women — contemporary and historical, gathered from across the world and across many narrations. We've brought over 60 reciters into one calm, beautiful space, so that every listener — and especially the next generation of girls — can hear the Qur'an in a voice that feels like their own.
about.commitmentBody: We're committed to honoring these reciters, and the Book they recite, with the care it deserves. Qariah will stay a respectful, thoughtfully curated home for the Qur'an, and we'll keep adding reciters and refining the experience, insha'Allah. Thank you for being part of this journey. May Allah accept it from us all.
about.highQualityAudioDesc: Crystal clear recitations from the world's best Qaris with optimized streaming

onboarding.tagline: Hear the Qurʾan in her voice
onboarding.welcomeBody: The first Qurʾan app celebrating contemporary and historical women reciters — bringing voices long unheard to a global audience.
onboarding.catalogBody: Curated with over 60 women reciters across the world and across several narrations. And more on the way.
onboarding.followAlongBody: Each ayah highlights in sync with the recitation so you never lose your place. Available for Zaynab Talha, expanding soon insha Allah.
onboarding.memorizeBody: Repeat a single ayah, play a range of verses, or loop an entire page. Built for hifdh and review.
onboarding.welcomeHeadline: Hear the Qurʾan in her voice.

release_3_3.arabicBody: Most of the app is now in Arabic, with a right-to-left layout and the reciters' names and bios in Arabic. It follows your phone's language, and you can change it anytime in Settings › Language.
release_3_3.widgetsBody: Add Qariah widgets to your Home Screen on iPhone and Android: continue listening or reading, play a surah, and see the ayah of the day.
release_3_3.recitationsBody: The Newly Added Recitations row on the Listen tab now shows the newest recitations: the surah, the reciter and the range of a partial recitation.
